name.description: The resource ID of the environment.
name.rationale: It sets the name of the environment and does not have any security impact.

org_id.description: The Apigee Organization associated with the Apigee environment, in the format organizations/{{org_name}}.
org_id.rationale: It sets the organization association and does not have any direct security impact.

display_name.rationale: It sets the display name only and does not have any security impact.

description.rationale: It sets the description only and does not have any security impact.

deployment_type.description: Deployment type supported by the environment. Possible values are: DEPLOYMENT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, PROXY, ARCHIVE.
deployment_type.rationale: Setting deployment_type to DEPLOYMENT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED may lead to unpredictable deployment behaviour and misconfigured environments. Always specify PROXY or ARCHIVE explicitly.

api_proxy_type.description: API Proxy type supported by the environment. Possible values are: API_PROXY_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, PROGRAMMABLE, CONFIGURABLE.
api_proxy_type.rationale: Setting api_proxy_type to API_PROXY_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED does not enforce a defined proxy execution model which can lead to misconfigured API proxies. Always specify PROGRAMMABLE or CONFIGURABLE explicitly.

type.description: Environment type. Possible values are: ENVIRONMENT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED, BASE, INTERMEDIATE, COMPREHENSIVE.
type.rationale: Setting type to ENVIRONMENT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED does not enforce a defined capability and capacity tier which may lead to misconfigured environments. Always specify BASE, INTERMEDIATE or COMPREHENSIVE explicitly.

forward_proxy_uri.description: URI of the forward proxy to be applied to the runtime instances in this environment. Must be in the format of {scheme}://{hostname}:{port}.
forward_proxy_uri.rationale: Using insecure schemes such as ftp, ssh, or telnet for the forward proxy exposes API traffic to interception and man-in-the-middle attacks. Only http:// or https:// schemes should be used.

node_config.description: NodeConfig for setting the min/max number of nodes associated with the environment.
node_config.rationale: It sets the node scaling configuration and does not have any security impact.

min_node_count.description: The minimum total number of gateway nodes reserved for all instances that have the specified environment.
min_node_count.rationale: It sets the minimum node count for scaling and does not have any security impact.

max_node_count.description: The maximum total number of gateway nodes reserved for all instances that have the specified environment.
max_node_count.rationale: It sets the maximum node count for scaling and does not have any security impact.

client_ip_resolution_config.description: The algorithm to resolve the client IP. This affects Analytics, API Security, and other features that use the client IP.
client_ip_resolution_config.rationale: Incorrect client IP resolution can allow malicious clients to spoof their IP address, undermining API Security, Analytics, and rate limiting features.

header_index_algorithm.description: Resolves the client IP based on a custom header.
header_index_algorithm.rationale: The header index algorithm determines which IP in the X-Forwarded-For header is used as the client IP. Incorrect configuration can allow IP spoofing.

ip_header_name.description: The name of the header to extract the client IP from. Currently only X-Forwarded-For is supported.
ip_header_name.rationale: It sets the header name for IP extraction. Only X-Forwarded-For is currently supported and does not have additional security impact.

ip_header_index.description: The index of the IP in the X-Forwarded-For header. Positive indices choose from the left (client-supplied), negative indices choose from the right (last verified hop).
ip_header_index.rationale: Using a non-negative index (0, 1, 2...) reads client-supplied IPs from the X-Forwarded-For header, which can be spoofed by malicious clients. Setting ip_header_index to -1 ensures the last verified hop is used, which cannot be spoofed.
